phase_note: Generated 2026-10-11/12 by the Phase 11 spec batch (wave 2) in auto-approve mode, in parallel with dashboards. 13 requirements / 92 acceptance criteria; 14 design components (four appended shared values: ProblemCodes, SequentialRamp, and the conditional helpers A1 format.format_durations, A2 frame.not_drawn_note, A3 format.duration_axis_title; the shared cells module; eight kind modules; the registry entries); 4 major / 18 leaf tasks: 17 executable plus 4.3*, an optional maintainer-only visual check that does not gate feature GO (chart-kit 7.2 precedent). (P): 1.2, 1.3, 2.1-2.8 (10); 1.1, 1.4 and groups 3-4 are sequential. Research: one read-only Explore subagent surveyed the analytics index tables the kinds are shaped for (mean_max, daily_load, weekly_load, zone_times, blocks, mesocycles, activities) and the query layer's value types; chart-kit's spec, the Phase 11 roadmap, steering, the dashboards brief and design, the Phase 10 second-lander precedent and the calendar queue item were read in context; three scratchpad probes computed contrast and OKLab/Machado-2009 distances for candidate sequential ramps, searched hue/lightness/chroma, and verified the chosen ramp through palette._oklch_to_hex; the bundled dataviz skill's colour formula was consulted. Downgrade: no WebSearch/WebFetch (the controller ruled the run network-free); WCAG, Machado 2009 and OKLab are cited from knowledge. Step 3.5 task-graph review ran as an independent reviewer dispatched by the controller, twice. Round 1: NEEDS_FIXES (3 blocking, 13 should-fix, 5 nits), all applied. Design edits from round 1 (d79162c, 32e8955, 1c22c23, c6f8246): cells ranked directly after scales and before frame (controller ruling, option a), so the rank matrix enforces its import limits and from . import marks in cells.py is a real control; conditional A3 for chart-kit's axis_title, which takes no duration-form argument; a grid kind's absent value is a drawable cross, so the no-data second line applies to a grid only when no row can be placed, with calendar-heatmap gaining an absent_dates golden; band single with low = mid = high; mean-max typical with an absent value; calendar constant on a round edge and durations spanning one hour; the zero stub through theme.STROKE.base; task cross-references corrected. Requirement 2.5 wording was clarified in round 1 for the grid kinds (a row whose value is absent leaves a cross, so the no-data state applies when no row can be placed); the controller RATIFIED this requirements edit at Step 3.5 round 2, for the maintainer's requirements review. Task repairs from round 1: the second-lander task 4.1 cites dashboards' published seam at its 2bdc103 (dashboard-kinds markers, writer tests.dashboards.test_docs_dashboards, no kind count, its task 7.3), and the one expected red test between 3.1 and 4.1 is stated; small-multiples auto columns 3 at 720 px; an exact-vector rule decides A1-A3 consume versus append; purity and clock controls; absent-to-zero mutations in every kind; the shared test helpers are read-only. Round 2: PASS, with all 21 round-1 findings verified resolved and no new conflicts. Six nits applied after the PASS without a further review: research and design wording (task 4.1; the classify mutations replacing a false zero-joins-bin-1 claim), 1.3's observable no longer waits on 1.2, the A3 vector states hours=True, mean-max's pace mutation names the description range, 3.1 shows chart-kit's three cross-cutting tests visit the catalog kinds by mutation instead of re-deriving them (the re-derivation bullet was dropped), and the preservation diff lists chart-kit's unedited cross-cutting test modules. Maintainer-visible: (1) the grid kinds carry magnitude by cell area with an in-band sequential ramp as a second carrier, because chart-kit's 3:1-on-four-backgrounds rule leaves no lightness-monotone colour ramp (adjacent steps about 0.05 OKLab, 0.037 under tritanopia), so they look like proportional-area grids, not GitHub-style solid cells; (2) signed values on a grid kind are refused (negative_value), with a diverging scale for form calendars deferred as a follow-on; (3) dual-axis ships per the discovery decision despite the dataviz anti-pattern, guarded by a dash on the second series, a legend naming each axis side, left-only gridlines and a shared_unit refusal; (4) box takes precomputed quartiles, so the kit computes no quantile.
